program: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) — Illinois still calls it "Food Stamps"/"FS" in some worker-facing manual sections
agency: Illinois Department of Human Services (IDHS), Family Community Resource Centers (FCRCs)
admin_note: State-administered: IDHS runs SNAP directly through Family Community Resource Centers (FCRCs); there are no independent county eligibility agencies. Policy lives in the Cash, SNAP, and Medical Manual as a PAIRED Policy Manual (PM, narrative rule) + Workers' Action Guide (WAG, operational detail and dollar tables) for every numbered section — amended by numbered Manual Releases (MR) and interim Policy Memoranda. The eligibility system is IES (Integrated Eligibility System); the public application/case-management portal is ABE (Application for Benefits Eligibility).
system: IES (Integrated Eligibility System, worker-facing); Illinois Link is the EBT card brand

update_channels.name: Cash, SNAP, and Medical Manual — Policy Manual (PM) + Workers' Action Guide (WAG), amended by Manual Releases (MR)
IDHS Policy Memoranda (interim guidance ahead of the next Manual Release)

verification.method: Direct fetch of ~55 PM/WAG pages + 2 Manual Release/Policy Memo bulletins over plain curl (dhs.state.il.us — stable page.aspx?item=N URLs, no host blocking observed) → cross-read against the #619 Tranche-1 engine sourcing (already-verified SUA, drug-felony, RMP citations) and the USDA FNS FY26 COLA memo → draft → adversarial refute gate.
verification.gates: Cross-check: every pivotal dollar value and eligibility rule traced to its own PM/WAG page or Manual Release/Policy Memo (not a curated extract) before drafting. One live production bug found and fixed along the way (issue #701 / PR #702 — stale ABAWD waiver flag). Refute gate recorded in PROVENANCE.md.
sources: Policy Manual chapters PM 02, 03, 05, 07, 13, 17, 19, 21 and their paired Workers' Action Guide sections (dhs.state.il.us)
